payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into various factors that contribute to the stability of word embeddings, including properties of the words, data, and algorithms used.

claims.text: Factors contributing to the stability of word embeddings include properties of the word itself, properties of the training data, and properties of the algorithm used to construct the embeddings.
Domain and part-of-speech are key factors affecting the instability of word embeddings.
Lower frequency words tend to have lower stability, while higher frequency words generally exhibit higher stability, although medium-frequency words can show significant variance.
Curriculum learning, or the order in which words appear in training data, significantly impacts the stability of word embeddings.
